trace.final_response:
The only valid creation path is `createDecorator<T>(serviceId)`. It creates a callable parameter decorator typed as `ServiceIdentifier<T>`; using it anywhere except a constructor parameter throws. [instantiation.ts:107](/{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:107)

Identifiers are cached in `_util.serviceIds`, a `Map` keyed by the service-ID string. `createDecorator` returns the existing identifier when that string is already present; otherwise it creates the decorator, assigns its string representation, caches it, and returns it. Thus equal service-ID strings produce the same identifier object. [instantiation.ts:12](/{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:12) [instantiation.ts:109](/{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109)

When invoked as a parameter decorator, it records `{ id, index }` on the constructor under `$di$dependencies`. The `$di$target` marker ensures inherited metadata is not mutated: an existing array is appended only when it belongs to that exact constructor; otherwise a fresh array and marker are installed. `getServiceDependencies` returns this array or an empty array. [instantiation.ts:16](/{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:16) [instantiation.ts:97](/{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:97)

One direct consumer is `backup.ts`: it imports `createDecorator` and calls it at module initialization to define `IBackupMainService`. Changes to caching or decorator behavior therefore directly affect that exported service identifier. [backup.ts:7](/{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/backup/electron-main/backup.ts:7)

arguments.query: ServiceIdentifier only valid creation factory identifiers cached constructor dependencies recorded directly affected caller importer behavior changes

trace.final_response:
The only valid creation path is `createDecorator<T>(serviceId)`. `refineServiceDecorator` merely retypes an existing identifier; it does not create one. The source explicitly labels `createDecorator` as the sole valid factory. [`instantiation.ts:107`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:107)

Identifiers are cached by their string `serviceId` in `_util.serviceIds`, a process-local `Map`. `createDecorator` returns the existing function object when the key is already present; otherwise it creates the callable parameter decorator, assigns its string representation, caches it, and returns it. Thus equal service-ID strings resolve to the same identifier object. [`instantiation.ts:14`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:14) [`instantiation.ts:109`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109)

When used on a constructor parameter, that function records `{ id, index }` on the constructor’s `$di$dependencies` property. `$di$target` distinguishes metadata owned by that constructor from inherited metadata: the first dependency creates a new array and ownership marker; subsequent dependencies for the same target are appended. `getServiceDependencies` returns that array or an empty array. [`instantiation.ts:16`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:16) [`instantiation.ts:97`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:97)

A directly affected caller is `InstantiationService._createInstance`: it reads this metadata, sorts dependencies by parameter index, resolves each identifier, and passes the resulting services to `Reflect.construct`. Any change to identifier identity, caching, or dependency recording therefore changes constructor injection here. trace.final_response:
The framework-declared only valid way to create a `ServiceIdentifier<T>` is `createDecorator<T>(serviceId)`, whose source comment states that contract explicitly. [`instantiation.ts:107`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:107)

- Identifiers are interned in `_util.serviceIds`, a `Map` keyed by the service-ID string. `createDecorator` returns the existing identifier when the key is present; otherwise it creates the callable decorator, sets its string representation, caches it, and returns it. Thus repeated calls with the same string return the same function object. [`instantiation.ts:14`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:14) [`instantiation.ts:109`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109)

- When used as a constructor-parameter decorator, the identifier requires the three decorator arguments and records `{ id, index }` on the constructor under `$di$dependencies`. `$di$target` identifies which constructor owns that array: existing own metadata is appended to, while a subclass or fresh constructor receives a new array instead of mutating inherited metadata. `getServiceDependencies` returns that array or `[]`. [`instantiation.ts:16`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:16) [`instantiation.ts:97`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:97)

- One exact direct caller is `ITroubleshootIssueService`, which creates its identifier with `createDecorator<ITroubleshootIssueService>(...)`; changes to creation, caching, or decorator recording therefore affect it directly. [`issueTroubleshoot.ts:33`]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0ffeffb/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/workbench/contrib/issue/browser/issueTroubleshoot.ts:33)
